invariants: One branch, one name: every row builds on feat/NO_JIRA-frontend-alignment in each repo it touches (ins #27, animals #339, plants #69, tests #227). No new branch, no new pull request.
Main is brought in by merging origin/main into the branch, once per repo. Never rebase the branch and never force-push.
Never merge a pull request. Only Sam merges, and only Sam lifts the drafts.

Sam's rulings of 24 September stand: the branch is to merge; the alignment adopts EUDPA-619 as it stands and conforms to it, never the reverse; the machine-drafted Welsh stays, and any new Welsh copy file carries the same machine-drafted header; these five repos are the only consumers of their URLs, so no redirect or deprecation is owed for a URL they drop.
Precedence: Sam's rulings, then main for behaviour, then the alignment ledger (stages.json) for structure and naming, then the branch as it stands.

Every merge-row conflict and every clean-but-wrong file is resolved exactly as resolutions.json records it; a row never re-decides a resolution. If the live tree disagrees with resolutions.json, stop that row and record why.

Lockfiles are regenerated, never hand-merged: ins, animals and plants under the pinned npm 11.6.2, the tests repo with plain npm. Agents cannot install; the main session runs every install and lockfile regeneration.
Pre-align work lands as its own commits on the branch before the merge; wire-in and follow-up work lands as its own commits after it.

Each row ends with its repos' ladder green: lint, format, unit tests and build in each frontend; type-check and lint in the tests repo. The end-to-end rung runs once, in the cross-repo end-to-end row, because the four merges agree on URLs, cookie names and sign-out only once all have landed.
No '#/' import specifier enters ins; every import follows the branch's relative convention.
